full_page.content:
1926, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 35 Cont.
Nov. 24th Apendix Saved - Doctor Disappointed & Angered. Walter Sullivan 22 - 209 E. Philad. Ave - ( clerk in People's State Bank) very sick of apendicitis, waiting in St. Mary's Hospital for operation to be performed at 7 p.m. All Saints Day, at about 3.30 p.m. same day a request for enrollment came by phone - as a perpetual mem- ber in S.M.A. At 7.17 p.m. phone brought word: "No operation .. Dr. wanted to operate, but we are just leaving Hospital now ... He - the patient - will be up to see you tomorrow." He drove the car home himself while all said litany His Father reciting by heart and the rest answering - litany of B.V.Mary. To-day he comes with his Mother in perfect condition - has been work- ing ever since. Deo Gratias
Dec. 2nd Non Cath. Edw'd Dold 58, Grosse Iile, Hardening of arteries and complication and "stroke" enrolled this evening for one year by non-Cath daughter Cath.
Dec. 8 Heart-trouble Hardening of Arteries Tumor & medically hopeless Miss Margaret McDonough 60, of Jackson Mich. (641 Oak Hill Ave.) enrolled Sept. (2nd time) for heart trouble, hardening of Arterie, tumor or cancer of stomach, swolen limbs, etc - given up by doc- tors as hopeless - Reported To-day as able to be around again, with fair apetite notably better.
Dec. 14 11.a.m. Elizabeth Zindler 4, of. .... given up by the doctors is enrolled by phone at 11 a.m. To-day. ( by Mary Sullivan of Beaver Realty)
Dec. 29th Frank Weinberg 70 of 3729 Seminole down for two weeks, sickly, with complication not to confessions for years --- Enrolled to- night perpetually.
Dorothy Dettloff 13393 Young Ave. only baby after ten years pray- ing to be blest with children, is enrolled the day of her birth when dispaired of and receives transfusion of blood same day. Three days after she received another transfusion and To-day after 7 months is the picture of health. The Doctor (E. Robinson) a non catholic wondered at the recover as a positive miracle de- claring "Indeed there must be a divine power behind such a cure."
